text:
I'll calculate the number of days between those two dates for you.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
from datetime import date

start_date = date(2015, 12, 17)
end_date = date(2019, 2, 24)

difference = end_date - start_date
print(f"Start date: {start_date}")
print(f"End date: {end_date}")
print(f"Number of days: {difference.days}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

**The number of days from 2015-12-17 to 2019-02-24 is 1,165 days.**
